india_trends.title: Investors turn to riskier bets as large-cap funds see net outflows in July
india_trends.summary: Large-cap funds saw outflows of ₹1,321 crore in July, the first monthly outflow in nearly three years, according to data from the Association of Mutual Funds of India. By contrast, investors pumped ₹7,767 crore into small-cap funds during the month, while mid-cap funds saw inflows of ₹6,192 crore.
